summary: Backups are staged at `/var/backups/automation-platform` (variable `backup_dir`); mount a bigger volume or change `backup_dir` before `./setup.sh -b`. Bundled installs install ansible-core from the bundle, and an existing DNF-installed ansible-core (2.16 required for 2.6) is detected and kept.
